text.body: ॥ śivanakṣatramālikāstotram ॥ . śrīkaṇṭhassāmba īśānaḥ pārvatīprāṇavallabhaḥ । vṛṣārūḍho viṣṇusakhaśśiva eva gatirmama ॥ 1 paramātmā parabrahma pañcāsyaḥ parameśvaraḥ । parātparataraṃ dhāma śivaeva gatirmama ॥ 2 nirālambo nirākāro nirmalo nirupadravaḥ । nityaśuddho niṣkalaṅkaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 3 śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśassūryacandrāgnilocanaḥ । śūlaṭaṅkadharaśśarvaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 4 bhūrayo viṣṇubāṇaśca vedāśvo brahmasārathiḥ । tripurārirmerudhanvā śivaeva gatirmama ॥ 5 vyāghracarmāmbaragharo vyālayajñopavītavān । bhavābhīṣṭaprado nityaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 6 kālakālo mahākālo bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ । kailāsanilayaśśambhu śiśavaeva gatirmama ॥ 7 rudrākṣamālābharaṇastripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakaḥ । pramatheśo mahādevaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 8 gaurīkānto vāmadevo nīlagrīvo digambaraḥ। gaṅgādharaścandracūḍaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 9 mūrtitrayasvarūpāḍhyo guṇatrayavivarjitaḥ । kāryatrayavidhātā ca śivaeva gatirmama ॥ 10 sadyojāto bhairavaśva mārkaṇḍeyavarapradaḥ । viṣṇucakrapradātā ca śivaeva gatirmama ॥ 11 aghoramūrtissarveśo vedavedyo dayānidhiḥ । kapālayuktahastābja śśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 12 aṣṭamūrtistatpuruṣa stathaikādaśa mūrtimān । pañcaviṃśati līlātmā śivaeva gatirmama ॥ 13 śatarudrasvarūpāḍhyo nandibhṛṅgi varapradaḥ । sadāśivo'nantarūpaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 14 mahāliṅgodbhavaśśānto ruṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇaḥ । triyambako virūpākṣa śśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 15 nirañjanaḥ paraṃjyoti ssaccidānandavigrahaḥ । māyāśabararūpāḍhya śśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 16 liṅgarūpo daśabhujaścograḥpaśupatirbhavaḥ । kāmeśvaro jagadrakṣaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 17 kalyāṇasundarākāraḥ kāmitārthavarapradaḥ । hālāsyalīlālolaśca śivaeva gatirmama ॥ 18 mṛtyuñjayo mahāraudrassomasskando maheśvaraḥ । bāṇāsuraparitrātā śivaeva gatirmama ॥ 19 jalandharaśiraśchettā nāgālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ । gajacarmāmbaradharaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 20 bhavarogaharaḥ pūjyo bhayakṛdbhayanāśanaḥ । dakṣiṇāmūrti rūpāḍhya śśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 21 sandhyānaṭo haro radro bhasmāsuravarapradaḥ । pinākabhṛnmanmathāriśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 22 mṛḍo brahmaśiraśchettā vināyakavarapradaḥ । umāmaheśvaro devaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 23 mahāprabhurmahāyogī bhūtasaṅgasamāvṛtaḥ । nāradādimunistutyaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 24 dakṣādhvaraharo vīraḥ kālakoṭiviṣāśanaḥ । gaṇeśaśāstṛjanaka śśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 25 kuberamitro bhīmeśo girīśo mohinīpriyaḥ । devāsurādisaṃsevyaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 26 sthāṇurhariharātmā ca rāmatārakamantradaḥ । śaṅkaraścārdhanārīśaśśivaeva gatirmama ॥ 27 śrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇa śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ । śrīkṛṣṇendro bhaktiyuktaśśivanakṣatramālikām ॥ 28 racayitvārpayāmāsa śrīkaṇṭhahṛdayāmbuje । trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktyā śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt ॥ mallikāvṛttamratnaśailanagāvanīśakacandrapallavahāyane siddhamāsasitāṣṭamī śaśivāsare kanakojvalā । candraśekharapādayoḥ khakhapūrṇa rūpamitākṣarā kṛṣṇabhūpasamarpitā gajabhānunāma sumālikā ॥ 30 ॥ iti śrīśivanakṣatramālikāstotram ॥
